title: Guide Stephanie was amazing
text: We really enjoyed the tour and our guide Stephanie was amazing. We learned and saw more in a short time than we could have seen on foot in a few days...
author: Saulius G

title: Great e-bike tour
text:
An e-bike tour is always first on our list of activities when visiting foreign cities, especially with active teenagers.  You can get a remarkable overview of a city in a short time, keep active and hope to remember some of the historical facts!  

Our guide was Stephanie, intelligent, knowledgeable and well qualified to share the history of Barcelona with us.  Her English was very good.  In addition she was happy to pass on recommendations for restaurants and other visitors attractions at the end of the tour.

title: Electric Bine tour was electrifying

author: Bonnie_Y

title: Barcelona ebike tour
text: Andrei was very knowledgeable and a terrific guide. He customized our tour through Barcelona based on what we wanted to see. Highly recommended him and the tour.

title: Great Experience
text: Andrei was a great guide and was very flexible with the agenda.  He anlso provided advice on restaurants. Overall a very good experience.
author: Robert_O

title: Get your bearings in Barcelona.
text: Andries was wonderful! It was a perfect way to spend the morning of our first day in Barcelona, to see the see sites and get our bearings. Thank you

title: The best way to see Barcelona!
text: THE best way to see Barcelona! So fun! So doable! Our guide (Triego..) was patient, knowledgeable, full of information and accommodated our ‘wish list’. Great guide, great tour. Do this one.
author: Mindy_W

title: Want to see it all in a small time
text: Miguel was fantastic. He took his time explaining everything to us! A great way to see the highlights in a short time!
author: Melissa_L

title: Great guide in a great city
text:
With Stefanie it was an amazing day seeing all the beauty of Barcelona per bike. She showed us every single point of interest. She is so emphatic and we enjoyed her company.
